hero.title: From the Farm. To Your Door.
hero.subtitle: Globuss Solutions builds direct relationships with growers across Asia and North Africa, then every shipment is inspected, lab-tested, and packed at our Berlin facility to strict German and EU quality standards — built for supermarkets, wholesalers, and distributors who need traceable, reliable supply.

intro.title: A supply chain you can put on a customs form
intro.body: Every shipment is documented from origin to delivery — phytosanitary certificates, certificates of analysis, and full traceability back to the source region. We source only from countries permitted to export to the EU, and every shipment is handled under whichever EU control requirements currently apply to that product and origin.

sourcing.title: Direct from growers
sourcing.desc: We work directly with farming communities across South and Southeast Asia and North Africa — not commodity brokers — to secure consistent quality and fair, stable pricing.

berlin.title: German quality control
berlin.desc: Every batch is inspected and lab-tested in Berlin before packing — moisture content, purity, and contaminant screening — to the standard German and EU food-safety regulation demands.

logistics.title: Built for export
logistics.desc: Commercial invoices, packing lists, and certificates of origin are prepared to the standard freight forwarders and customs brokers expect — no back-and-forth.

markets.title: EU · US · Middle East
markets.desc: Our trade documentation and pricing structures are built to move across EU, US, and GCC import requirements from the outset.

scale.title: Wholesale-first
scale.desc: We're structured around B2B volumes — supermarkets, wholesalers, and food-service distributors — not single-unit retail.

trust.title: One point of contact
trust.desc: A single team handles sourcing, documentation, and delivery — so you're never chasing three different parties for one shipment.

quality.title: What "German quality control" actually means
quality.body: Raw spices arrive in Berlin and pass through a strict quality process before a single bag is labeled — this is the standard we're building the business around, not a slogan on a label.
quality.stat1.label: Batches lab-tested
quality.stat2.label: 852/2004 hygiene standard

inspection.title: Incoming inspection
inspection.desc: Every batch is checked on arrival for moisture content, visible contamination, and physical condition before it's accepted into stock.

lab.title: Laboratory testing
lab.desc: Samples are tested for purity, pesticide residue, and microbial load, with results recorded against each batch's Certificate of Analysis.

packing.title: Hygienic packing
packing.desc: Packing follows EU food hygiene regulation (EC 852/2004), with metal detection and clean-room handling ahead of sealing.

trace.title: Full traceability
trace.desc: Every label carries a batch reference back to the growing region — origin honesty alongside German handling standards, not instead of it.

process.title: Farm to door, in four stages

step1.title: Sourced at the farm
step1.desc: Raw spices and agricultural goods sourced directly from growers across Asia and North Africa.

step2.title: Lab-tested & packed
step2.desc: Goods are received, lab-tested, and packed under German hygiene standards at our Berlin facility.

step3.title: Cleared for export
step3.desc: Full trade documentation prepared for EU, US, and Middle East import requirements.

step4.title: To your door
step4.desc: Delivered to supermarkets, wholesalers, and distributors across three continents.

coming.title: Expanding beyond spices
coming.body: We're building our own production line for pickles and bottled water — not a relabeled third-party product, but a Globuss-made line packaged in biodegradable materials and built on the same direct-sourcing principles as our spice range. Details and availability will be announced as we move toward launch.

cta.title: Sourcing for your shelves, your kitchens, or your private label?
cta.subtitle: Tell us your volumes and markets — we'll put together a sourcing and pricing proposal built around your business.

about.title: Built on direct relationships, not middlemen
about.intro: Globuss Solutions & Co. GmbH is a Berlin-based trading company built around one idea: the shortest possible distance between the farmer who grows something and the business that sells it.

story.title: Why we exist
story.part1: Most spices and agricultural goods change hands four or five times between the farm and the shelf — each step adding cost, removing traceability, and diluting quality control.
story.part2: Globuss Solutions is being built to close that gap. We're establishing direct relationships with growers across South and Southeast Asia and North Africa, and building a Berlin base where every shipment is inspected, lab-tested, and packed under strict German and EU food-safety standards before it moves on to buyers across Europe, the United States, and the Middle East.
story.part3: We're honest about where each spice is grown — and just as serious about the handling standard it passes through once it reaches us. That combination, origin transparency plus German quality control, is the whole point.
story.note: We're a young company. We'd rather be straightforward about that than overstate where we are — what we can promise is transparency in every relationship we build, starting with this one.

part1.title: Traceability
part1.desc: Every order can be traced back to its region of origin, with the certificates to prove it — not just a country-of-origin label.

part2.title: German quality control
part2.desc: Lab testing, hygienic packing, and metal detection at our Berlin facility, to EU food hygiene regulation EC 852/2004 — the same handling standard buyers expect from established German processors.

part3.title: Fair sourcing
part3.desc: Working directly with growers means cutting out layers of brokers — better margins for the farms we work with, and better pricing for our buyers.

part4.title: Documentation discipline
part4.desc: Commercial invoices, packing lists, and certificates prepared right the first time, to the standard customs brokers and freight forwarders expect.

part5.title: Built for scale
part5.desc: Structured from day one for wholesale and B2B volumes, not single-unit retail — because that's who we're built to serve.

based.title: Berlin, by design
based.body: Germany's reputation for regulatory rigor and logistics infrastructure makes it the natural base for a company built around export to the EU, US, and Middle East. Every batch is inspected and packed here under German and EU food-safety standards — while the spice itself stays honestly labeled to its true growing region.

sourcing.note: A note on sourcing: there is no single "approved country" whitelist for spice imports into the EU. Instead, every shipment is screened against current EU food-safety control requirements (Regulation (EU) 2019/1793 and related rules), which vary by product and origin and are updated every six months. We source only from countries permitted to export to the EU and build our documentation around whichever control level currently applies.

products.title: Spices, sourced and documented by origin
products.intro: Every product line is sourced from named growing regions permitted for EU import, then lab-tested and packed in Berlin under German and EU food-safety standards. Documentation prepared to EU, US, and GCC import requirements. Available for wholesale and private-label inquiry.

items.title: Pepper & Cardamom
items.desc: Black pepper, white pepper, and whole green cardamom sourced directly from growing regions in Kerala, India and the Vietnamese highlands. Available whole or ground, packed to buyer specification.

items.title: Cinnamon, Cloves & Nutmeg
items.desc: True cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum) and cassia, whole cloves, and nutmeg sourced from established growing regions across South and Southeast Asia, inspected and repacked in Berlin.

items.title: Chilli, Turmeric & Cumin
items.desc: Core Indian spice staples — chilli powder, turmeric, and cumin — along with custom masala blends formulated to buyer specification and packed under the Globuss brand or private label.

items.title: North African Herbs & Spice Blends
items.desc: Dried herbs and specialty spice blends sourced from North African and Eastern Mediterranean growing regions, for buyers looking to diversify beyond South Asian spice lines.

items.title: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
items.desc: Cold-pressed extra virgin olive oil sourced directly from Mediterranean mills, with full acidity and peroxide profiles verified on arrival in Berlin. Available in bulk drums, IBC totes, and retail glass bottles.
items.pack: Bulk (1000L IBC, 200L drum), 1L/5L retail glass or PET

items.title: Sunflower Oil
items.desc: Refined and high-oleic sunflower oil for food-service, industrial, and retail buyers. Sourced from established crushing regions and shipped in flexitank, IBC, or filled bottle formats.

items.title: Palm Oil (RSPO)
items.desc: RSPO-certified refined palm oil and palm olein for food manufacturers and industrial use. Sourced from segregated supply chains with full traceability documentation to mill level.
items.forms: RBD palm oil, palm olein, palm stearin

oils.title: Cooking oils for wholesale & industrial buyers
oils.intro: Olive, sunflower and RSPO-certified palm oil — sourced from established producing regions and delivered in bulk, IBC or retail-ready formats, with full documentation for German and EU importers.

own.title: Pickles & bottled water
own.body: Unlike our spice range, which we source and process, this line will be produced in-house by Globuss: small-batch pickles and bottled water, made and packaged by us in biodegradable materials. Built on the same direct-sourcing and traceability principles as our spice range, this line will be announced as it nears launch.
